 
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedshiftClusterCreationInS3",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "redshift:CreateCluster",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowGlueTableAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "glue:DescribeTable",
        "glue:ListTables",
        "glue:GetTable",
        "glue:UpdateTable",
        "glue:DeleteTable",
        "glue:CreateTable",
        "glue:UpdateDatabase",
        "glue:DeleteDatabase",
        "glue:CreateWorkGroup",
        "glue:UpdateWorkGroup",
        "glue:DeleteWorkGroup"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowLambdaFunctionExecution",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "lambda:CreateFunction",
        "lambda:UpdateFunctionCode",
        "lambda:PublishVersion",
        "lambda:RevokePermission",
        "lambda:GrantExecutePermission",
        "lambda:InvokingFunction"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowEC2VolumeDeletion",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "ec2:DeleteVolume"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-west-2"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowS3BucketLogging",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:GetBucketLogging",
        "s3:PutBucketLogging"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-west-2"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowAthenaQueryExecution",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "athena:StartQueryExecution",
        "athena:StopQueryExecution"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowKMSKeyUsage",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey",
        "kms:ImportDataKey",
        "kms:RevokeKey",
        "kms:Sign",
        "kms:Verify",
        "kms:CreateKey",
        "kms:DescribeKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRoute53RRSetChanges",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-west-2"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowSQSServiceAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "sqs:SendMessage",
        "sqs:ReceiveMessage",
        "sqs:DeleteMessageBatch"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-west-2"
        }

      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
